author: Black Archie Character
text:
I don't understand the problem with these notes. These are normal annotations. It's very common for academics to study like this. When I read an instruction book from the 1950s, I typed the paragraphs from the book to the computer and then summarized the text I had just written.

topReplies.author: Cruxador
topReplies.text: These are not normal notes. Did you read them? She doesn't understand what she's reading on even a basic level.

topReplies.author: Black Archie Character
topReplies.text: This is normal. Picture #2 is like the Cornell and charting method. When taking notes like this, the purpose isn't solely to understand but to integrate the information and create new ideas. The advice is that you first read for fun and then for analysis. This is level 3 reading.

topReplies.author: Cruxador
topReplies.text: The format is normal; I know all that. I asked if you read them for a reason. Look at the content of the notes, not just the structure.

topReplies.author: Black Archie Character
topReplies.text: I don't know her reading goal or her system of notetaking. Her first picture shows her trying to identify the themes within the book but looking for ideas. The second picture looks like a notetaking worksheet used to analyze a powen. I had to do the same as a student.
